note: Z-Anatomy -> BodyParts3D. The 42 landmark rules of landmark_anchors.py run on the BP3D bones (right bones with the left rule mirrored) against landmarks.json; global similarity by Umeyama, a residual similarity (or translation, under 6 points) per MVMT region, blended by a Gaussian of the distance to each region's landmarks (sigma 0.12 m, floor 0.02). Residuals are the blended transform at the landmark, in metres.

frames.zanatomy: Z up, +X left, -Y anterior (the fit's own frame)
frames.bp3d: Y up, +X left, +Z anterior (atlas.json and our glTF export)
